description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the product interfaces, backend systems, and internal tools that power reinforcement learning data workflows. You will work with research engineers and external partners to turn complex needs into polished tools for creating, evaluating, and improving training data.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior.

 - Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data.

 - Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health.

 - Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality review, and training infrastructure.

 - Collaborate with research, operations, and go-to-market teams to ship useful systems in ambiguous environments.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of full-stack engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with a technical education or equivalent technical background.

 - Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js.

 - Hands-on experience with AI, machine learning, or reinforcement learning, and ownership of products from design through deployment.

 - Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, along with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging.

 - Experience creating dashboards, observability interfaces, data inspection tools, review workflows, or quality assessment products.

 - Data collection, annotation, labeling, evaluation, developer tools, or partner-facing workflow experience is valuable. Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or Grafana is also useful.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary range: $130,000 to $225,000 annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for qualifying full-time candidates.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, or Singapore. Remote candidates may be considered if they can maintain 70% to 80% time zone overlap with either location.
